scope.purpose: Let the user type one wall-clock time of day in a form, in the hour cycle of the locale or a forced one.
useCases: An opening hour, an appointment or departure time.
A time with seconds (a log filter).
exclusions: A list of times to pick from (TimePicker, later).
A step between allowed minutes (user, 2026-11-23: no step in v1).
Time zones, durations, a range across midnight.
alternatives: Select for a few fixed times.
NumberInput with a unit for a duration.

versions.bitsUi: not used (TimeField rejected at implementation, see decisionsTaken)

examples.preview: dist/previews/time-input.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview time-input)

contract.scope: TimeInput contract: value HH:mm or HH:mm:ss, min, max, locale, hourCycle auto|h12|h23, seconds, size, disabled, readonly, invalid, required, name; segmented field without slot and without step.
contract.provenance: User at the grouped wave 6 contract gate in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/4GYW7vKacsTMookDzhFsA2 (version 1795428233-4cd9): "1. Ok, 2. À voir à l'implémentation je ne me rends pas trop compte à l'écrit, 3. Ok pour les boutons séparés. Est-ce qu'on pourrait faire en sorte que flèche du haut et flèche du bas change de 1, et que shift + flèche du haut de 10 (comme sur figma). 4. Ok 5. Ok. Pour le reste, je valide les contrats".

decisionsTaken: Values are ISO strings where a date or time is involved; @internationalized/date (a peer dependency of Bits UI) is declared as a peer dependency of the package and used internally only (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T1: "Ok pour moi, les dates font partie de ces choses difficiles à traiter sans dépendance externe").

Locale is a prop (BCP 47, default "en"), deterministic on the server; no application-wide locale provider: components are delivered as units with settings only, each project integrates its global logic (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T2).

Segment names come from Intl.DisplayNames(locale, dateTimeField) and button labels are props with English defaults, replacing the English strings hard-coded in Bits UI (contract over Bits UI; User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T3).

Invalid belongs to the application: min and max limit the controls but never set invalid by themselves (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T5).

hourCycle prop auto, h12, h23 (auto follows the locale) and seconds boolean (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping: "hourcycle comme paramètre"). Enum values must start with a letter, hence h12 and h23, the names Intl uses for 1-12 and 00-23.
Size sm, md, lg like InputText and Select; no slot and no button: there is nothing to open.

Bits UI TimeField is not used (implementation, 2026-11-23; to confirm at the implementation gate): in bits-ui 2.19.3 the day period is read as `value === "PM" ? "PM" : "AM"` (internal/date-time/formatter.js:146), so every 12-hour locale whose period is not written PM (ko 오후, ja 午後, ar م, en-GB pm, es p. m.) shows an afternoon time as morning, and two presses on the period go through a wrong value; h12 forced on a 24-hour locale (fr, de) renders no day period at all, so an afternoon time cannot be typed. The component writes its parts itself (time.ts: layout from Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatToParts, typing, stepping), as Select and Combobox do (decision Contract versus Bits UI). It therefore uses neither Bits UI nor @internationalized/date.
nextAction: Implementation gate (wave 6, grouped): present the review pages, the exercise list and the limits; record the approval with source digests.
implementationNotes: Each part is a contenteditable span exposed as a spin button (inputmode numeric, or text for the day period) so that mobile keyboards open; text arrives through beforeinput (mobile keyboards send no usable key) and is never applied by the browser. Arrow keys come from keydown.
Parts are named by aria-labelledby: the Field label (or a hidden span holding the label prop) and a hidden span holding the part name from Intl.DisplayNames(locale, dateTimeField).
Left and Right Arrow go to the nearest part on that side on screen (bounding boxes), so they follow the reading direction and the bidirectional order of a time in a right-to-left page.
Digits are shown in the locale's numbering system (Arabic-Indic in ar-EG) and accepted when typed in it.
Enter submits the enclosing form, as in a text input.
min and max are taken out of the attributes and not used: the contract leaves invalid to the application (question for the implementation gate: keep or remove them).

informational.reason: Same field colors as InputText (color.input.*): its exemption accepted at the wave 2 contract gate (2026-10-26, "4 ok") applies; color.input.default.border reaches 2.06 on surface.muted in dark, a de-emphasized backdrop where forms are not expected.
